title: agent.attention v1
description: What an agent session needs from the human operator, as of its latest turn. Published by the needs-you Stop hook (adapters/needs-you/) at the end of every Claude Code turn that carries a 'Needs you' block. Latest event per session_id wins: an event with empty items clears that session's earlier asks. Consumers (dashboards, deer-flow) render one cross-project queue from it so the operator does not have to read full turn output.

session_id.description: Claude Code session id; the supersede key

project.description: Project name (git common-dir parent; worktrees resolve to their parent repo)

cwd.description: Session working directory at turn end

items.description: Decisions or actions the operator must take, one line each. Empty = this session needs nothing.

summary.description: First prose line of the turn's reply; the phone's one-line 'done' text

name.description: Short session slug chosen by the agent (`needs-you name <slug>`) or defaulted from the worktree directory; shown instead of the session uuid

orca_terminal.description: Orca terminal handle (ORCA_TERMINAL_HANDLE) when the session runs in Orca; empty otherwise. Lets hearth deep-link and route answers.
